spec.title: Jump Game
taskFacts: Begin at the first index of an integer array. At each index, its value is the greatest forward jump length allowed, so shorter jumps are also allowed.
Return whether some sequence of jumps reaches the last index. A single-element input is already at the destination.

examples.explanation: A jump from index zero can reach index two, then the last index.
The only first jump lands on a zero before the destination.

easier.title: Climbing Stairs
easier.reason: Practice reasoning about reaching a position
